error.server: Sisitemu yacu ntiyabashije kubikora ubu. Ongera ugerageze nyuma y'iminota mike.
error.notFound: Ntitwabonye konti yawe. Hamagara serivisi y'abakiriya ba WASAC.
error.invalid: Hari ikitemewe muri ibi wohereje. Bigenzure maze wongere ugerageze.

camera.title: Soma mubazi yawe
camera.unavailable.title: Kamera ntiboneka
camera.unavailable.body: Emerera mushakisha (browser) gukoresha kamera mu igenamiterere ryayo, cyangwa wohereze ifoto ya mubazi yawe.
camera.photoKept: Ifoto yawe yabitswe, ntukeneye kongera kuyifata.
camera.saved: Ufite ifoto itaroherezwa. Yohereze, cyangwa ufate indi.
camera.notImage: Iyo dosiye si ifoto. Hitamo ifoto ya mubazi yawe.
camera.unreadable.title: Ntitwashoboye gusoma imibare iri kuri iyi foto
camera.unreadable.body: Sukura ikirahure cya mubazi, urebe ko hari urumuri, maze ufotore wegereye imibare.
camera.locationOff: Aho uri ntihagaragara, bityo umukozi azagenzura iki gipimo mbere ya fagitire yawe. Fungura aho uri (location) kugira ngo ibyo bitaba ngombwa.
camera.liveOff: Inama zihita zigaragara zahagaritswe kugira ngo uzigame interineti.
camera.liveEnded: Inama zihita zigaragara zahagaze. Fata ifoto igihe imibare iri mu kazu.
camera.cropAlt: Imibare ya mubazi, yakuwe ku ifoto yawe
guidance.noMeter: Ntitwabonye mubazi y'amazi. Erekeza kamera ku kazu k'imibare ka mubazi.
guidance.cutOff: Imibare imwe ishobora kuba itagaragara yose. Gerageza gusubira inyuma gato.
guidance.tooDark: Harasa n'ahijimye. Gerageza gucana itara cyangwa ukoreshe itara rya telefoni yawe.
guidance.glare: Hashobora kuba hari urumuri rwigaragaza ku kirahure. Gerageza guhengamira telefoni gato.
guidance.hardToRead: Imibare ntigaragara neza. Niba ikirahure cyanduye cyangwa gitose, gihanagure buhoro maze wongere ugerageze.
guidance.checkNumbers: Reba neza niba imibare ari yo.
guidance.aim: Erekeza kamera ku mibare ya mubazi, ntunyeganyege.
confirm.title: Genzura imibare
confirm.question: Iyi mibare irahura n'iri kuri mubazi yawe?
confirm.tapHint: Kanda ku mubare kugira ngo uwuhindure.
confirm.manual: Andika imibare 8 yose iri kuri mubazi yawe: 5 iri ku birabura, hanyuma 3 iri ku mutuku.
confirm.needsCheck: Twasomye {raw}. Genzura imibare iri kuri mubazi yawe maze uyandike hano.
confirm.needsCheckEmpty: Genzura imibare iri kuri mubazi yawe maze uyandike hano.
confirm.incomplete: Uzuza imibare 8 yose. Niba hari aho nta mubare ugaragara, andika 0.
confirm.retakeBody: Ntitwashoboye gukoresha iki gipimo. Ongera ufotore wegereye imibare kandi hari urumuri ruhagije.
confirm.notNow: Iki gipimo ntigishobora koherezwa ubu: igipimo giheruka kiracyagenzurwa, cyangwa igipimo cy'uku kwezi cyamaze kwakirwa. Ahabanza herekana igihe mushobora kohereza igikurikiraho.
held.title: Igipimo cyoherejwe
held.checkingBody: Umukozi wa WASAC arimo kugenzura iki gipimo. Narangiza, igisubizo kizagaragara mu Butumwa. Nta kindi usabwa gukora.
bill.title: Fagitire ya {month}
bill.howNote: Uko ukoresha amazi menshi mu kwezi, ni ko igiciro cya buri metero kibe y'inyongera kizamuka. Amafaranga ya serivisi ni amwe buri kwezi.
pay.title: Ishyura ukoresheje Mobile Money
pay.from: Uzishyura ukoresheje nimero ya MTN Mobile Money iri kuri konti yawe: {phone}.
pay.unsure: Ntitwashoboye kwemeza ubwishyu. Banza urebe fagitire zawe mbere yo kongera kugerageza, kugira ngo utishyura kabiri.
history.title: Fagitire zawe
history.empty: Nta fagitire uragira. Fata ifoto ya mbere ya mubazi yawe.
history.checking: Fagitire yawe ya mbere izagaragara hano umukozi wa WASAC namara kugenzura igipimo cyawe.
home.readPrompt: Soma mubazi yawe kugira ngo ubone fagitire ikurikira.
home.checkingBody: Umukozi wa WASAC arimo kugenzura igipimo wohereje. Igisubizo kizagaragara mu Butumwa. Nta kindi usabwa gukora.
home.readingInBody: Murakoze. Igipimo gikurikiraho mushobora kucyohereza guhera ku wa {date}.
gate.pendingBody: Umukozi wa WASAC arimo kugenzura igipimo mwohereje. Mushobora kohereza ikindi nyuma y'icyemezo; tuzabibamenyesha mu Butumwa.
home.highUse: Twabonye ko wakoresheje amazi menshi kurusha uko bisanzwe. Soma ubutumwa urebe ibyo ukwiye kugenzura.
messages.title: Ubutumwa
messages.empty: Nta butumwa. Tuzakubwira hano nitubona ikintu kidasanzwe ku mikoreshereze yawe y'amazi.
msg.SPIKE.title: Amazi menshi cyane kurusha uko bisanzwe
msg.SPIKE.noticed: Ku wa {date}, mubazi yawe yerekanye amazi menshi cyane kurusha ayo urugo rwawe rusanzwe rukoresha.
msg.SUSTAINED_HIGH.title: Amazi menshi kuva igihe runaka
msg.SUSTAINED_HIGH.noticed: Imikoreshereze yawe y'amazi imaze ibipimo byinshi iri hejuru y'uko bisanzwe, kugeza ku wa {date}.
msg.MISREAD_SUSPECTED.title: Igipimo kiri munsi y'icyaheruka
msg.MISREAD_SUSPECTED.noticed: Igipimo wohereje ku wa {date} kiri munsi y'icyaheruka. Mubazi zibara zizamuka gusa, ni yo mpamvu tugenzura ibipimo nk'ibi.
msg.METER_STUCK.title: Mubazi yawe ishobora kuba itagenda
msg.METER_STUCK.noticed: Mubazi yawe imaze igihe yerekana igipimo kimwe, kugeza ku wa {date}. Niba ukoresha amazi kandi imibare ntihinduke, hamagara serivisi y'abakiriya ba WASAC.
msg.UNUSUAL.title: Igipimo kidasanzwe
msg.UNUSUAL.noticed: Igipimo wohereje ku wa {date} gitandukanye n'uko usanzwe ukoresha amazi.
msg.LOCATION_CHECK.title: Turimo kugenzura aho ifoto yafatiwe
msg.LOCATION_CHECK.first_location: Ifoto mwohereje ku wa {date} ni yo ya mbere ivuye kuri mubazi yanyu. Umukozi ayigenzura rimwe akabika aho mubazi yanyu iri, bityo ibipimo bizakurikiraho bikemerwa ako kanya.
msg.LOCATION_CHECK.far: Ifoto wohereje ku wa {date} yafatiwe kure y'aho mubazi yawe iri mu nyandiko zacu, bityo umukozi azayigenzura mbere ya fagitire yawe.
msg.LOCATION_CHECK.no_location: Telefoni yawe ntiyagaragaje aho uri igihe wohereje ifoto ku wa {date}, bityo umukozi azagenzura igipimo mbere ya fagitire yawe.
msg.LOCATION_CHECK.imprecise: Aho telefoni yawe yerekanye ntihari hasobanutse bihagije igihe wohereje ifoto ku wa {date}, bityo umukozi azagenzura igipimo mbere ya fagitire yawe.
msg.LOCATION_CHECK.upload: Ifoto wohereje ku wa {date} wayikuye mu mafoto wari ufite, ntiwayifashe ako kanya na kamera, bityo umukozi azayigenzura mbere ya fagitire yawe.
msg.leak.checkTitle: Reba niba hari aho amazi ava:
msg.leak.check3: ubutaka cyangwa inkuta bitose hafi y'amatiyo yawe
msg.leak.cost: Amazi ava anyura muri mubazi yawe kandi abarwa kuri fagitire yawe, bityo kanika aho amazi ava vuba uko ubishoboye.
msg.status.open: Umukozi wa WASAC arimo kugenzura iki gipimo. Nta kindi usabwa gukora.
msg.status.followUp: Fagitire yawe yoherejwe nk'uko bisanzwe. Umukozi wa WASAC ashobora kubikurikirana; nta kindi usabwa gukora.
msg.status.accepted: Cyagenzuwe kandi cyemejwe. Fagitire yawe yabonetse.
msg.status.rejected: Ntitwashoboye kwemeza iki gipimo. Ongera usome mubazi yawe.

landing.lede: Fotora mubazi yawe, genzura imibare, maze wishyure fagitire yawe ukoresheje MTN Mobile Money.
landing.staffLink: Uri umukozi wa WASAC? Injira hano
landing.step1: Fotora imibare iri kuri mubazi yawe.
landing.step2: Genzura imibare twasomye maze ukosore iyo twibeshyeho.
landing.step3: Reba fagitire yawe maze uyishyure ukoresheje MTN Mobile Money.
error.unauthorized: Igihe cyawe cyo kwinjira cyarangiye. Ongera winjire.
error.locked: Wagerageje inshuro nyinshi zitari zo. Tegereza iminota 5, hanyuma wongere ugerageze.
error.conflict: Undi muntu yamaze kubikemura. Ongera ufungure urupapuro urebe ibigezweho.
error.tooMany: Wagerageje inshuro nyinshi mu gihe gito. Tegereza umunota umwe, hanyuma wongere ugerageze.
error.tooLarge: Iyi foto ni nini cyane. Fata indi foto, cyangwa uhitemo nto.
error.forbidden: Konti yawe ntiyemerewe gukora ibi. Niba ubikeneye, baza umuyobozi wa sisitemu.
demo.label: Amakuru y'igerageza
signin.title: Kwinjira kw'abakozi
signin.lede: Ni iy'abakozi ba WASAC bashinzwe fagitire n'abo mu murima. Genzura ibipimo byahagaritswe kandi ukurikirane ingo.
signin.wrong: Izina n'ijambo ry'ibanga ntibihura. Bigenzure maze wongere ugerageze.
signin.help: Wibagiwe ijambo ry'ibanga? Saba umuyobozi wa sisitemu kurisubiramo.
signin.household.title: Injira
signin.household.lede: Koresha nimero ya telefoni wanditseho muri WASAC. Turakoherereza kode kuri SMS. Nta jambo ry'ibanga rikenewe.
signin.household.badPhone: Andika nimero ya telefoni yo mu Rwanda, urugero 078 123 4567.
signin.household.notRegistered: Iyi nimero ntihuye na konti ya WASAC. Genzura nimero, cyangwa uhamagare WASAC kuri 1580.
signin.household.tooMany: Mwagerageje inshuro nyinshi. Tegereza iminota mike, hanyuma wongere ugerageze.
signin.household.codeLede: Twohereje kode y'imibare 6 kuri {phone} binyuze kuri SMS. Imara iminota 10.
signin.household.wrongCode: Iyo kode si yo, cyangwa yarangiye. Yigenzure, cyangwa usabe indi kode.
signin.household.demoBody: Konti z'igerageza ntizoherezwa SMS. Kode yawe ni
signin.household.chooseLede: Iyi nimero ifite mubazi zirenze imwe. Hitamo iyo ushaka kureba.
staff.sms.lede: Ubutumwa bwoherejwe binyuze muri SMS y'igerageza, ubwa vuba mbere. Iyi serivisi ntigera kuri telefoni nyazo, bityo kode zo kwinjira n'amatangazo murabisoma hano.
staff.sms.none: Nta SMS iroherezwa muri serivisi y'igerageza.
staff.roleCan.officer: Agenzura ibipimo byahagaritswe kandi abona ingo.
staff.roleCan.supervisor: Nk'umukozi, kandi abona ibikorwa by'abakozi bose.
staff.activity.ledeOwn: Igihe winjiriye n'ibyemezo wafashe, ibya vuba mbere.
staff.activity.ledeAll: Kwinjira kose, ibyemezo byose n'impinduka zose kuri konti, ibya vuba mbere.
staff.accounts.lede: Ongeramo abantu, ugene ibyo bemerewe gukora, kandi usubiremo amagambo y'ibanga yibagiranye.
staff.accounts.name: Amazina yose
staff.accounts.usernameHint: Inyuguti nto cyangwa imibare kuva kuri 3 kugeza kuri 32; akadomo n'akanyerezo biremewe. Urugero: a.mukamana
staff.accounts.roleHelp: Abakozi bagenzura ibipimo. Abagenzuzi babona n'ibikorwa by'abakozi bose. Abayobozi ba sisitemu bacunga na konti.
staff.accounts.badInput: Andika amazina yose n'izina ukoresha rifite inyuguti nto cyangwa imibare kuva kuri 3 kugeza kuri 32.
staff.accounts.resetConfirm: Guha {name} ijambo ry'ibanga ry'agateganyo rishya? Iryo akoresha ubu rizahita rireka gukora.
staff.accounts.issuedHelp: Rigaragara ubu gusa. Riha nyiraryo imbonankubone (atari kuri imeyili), maze umusabe kurihindura muri Konti yanjye.
staff.password.title: Hindura ijambo ry'ibanga
staff.password.temporary: Ijambo ry'ibanga wahawe ni iry'igihe gito. Rihindure hano; ibindi bice by'urubuga birafunguka nyuma yaho.
staff.password.hint: Nibura inyuguti {count}. Interuro ngufi yoroshye kwibuka.
staff.password.mismatch: Amagambo y'ibanga mashya yombi ntabwo ari kimwe.
staff.password.wrongCurrent: Ijambo ry'ibanga ukoresha ubu si ryo.
staff.password.changed: Ijambo ry'ibanga ryahinduwe. Hano ukomeza kwinjira; ahandi hose harasohoka.
staff.stat.openFlagsNote: Harimo aho amazi ashobora kuba ava
staff.households.search: Shakisha ukoresheje izina, mubazi cyangwa umurenge
staff.review.lede: Ibipimo {count} bitegereje. Gereranya buri kimwe n'imikoreshereze isanzwe y'urugo.
staff.review.keys: Utubuto: J ikurikira, K ibanziriza, A emeza, R anga, C funga, U subiza inyuma.
staff.review.where.first_location: Iyi mubazi nta hantu yanditseho. Kwemera bibika aho iyi foto yafatiwe (telefoni yizewe kugera kuri {accuracy}).
staff.review.where.far: {distance} uvuye kuri mubazi (telefoni yizewe kugera kuri {accuracy})
staff.review.where.imprecise: Ntibisobanutse: telefoni yizewe kugera kuri {accuracy} gusa
staff.review.where.upload: Yakuwe mu mafoto yari asanzwe, ntiyafashwe na kamera
staff.review.noPhoto: Nta foto y'iki gipimo (cyanditswe n'intoki, cyoherejwe kuri USSD, cyangwa gishaje kurusha igihe amafoto abikwa).
staff.review.acceptNote: Kwemeza bikora fagitire. Kwanga bisaba urugo, binyuze mu Butumwa, kohereza indi foto.
staff.review.rejected: Igipimo cya {name} cyanzwe. Bazasabwa kohereza indi foto.
staff.review.closeNote: Iki gipimo cyamaze gukorerwa fagitire. Gifunge umaze kugikurikirana, urugero usura mubazi.
staff.review.empty: Nta bipimo bitegereje icyemezo. Ibipimo bishya byahagaritswe bizagaragara hano.

notFound.body: Genzura aderesi, cyangwa usubire aho watangiriye.
pwa.iosHint: Kuri iPhone: kanda Sangiza (Share), hanyuma “Add to Home Screen”.
staff.correct.title: Kosora igipimo cya mubazi
staff.correct.lede: Iyo ibyanditswe na WASAC atari byo, urugero mubazi yasimbujwe, andika ibyo mubazi yerekana ubu. Igipimo gikurikiraho kizagereranywa na cyo. Ikosora ryose riba mu Bikorwa.
staff.correct.incomplete: Hitamo urugo, hanyuma wandike igipimo (kuva kuri 0 kugeza kuri 99999.999 m³) n'impamvu.
staff.correct.pending: Hari igipimo cy'uru rugo gitegereje mu bigomba kugenzurwa. Banza ugifateho icyemezo.
staff.correct.done: {meter} ubu yerekana {reading}. Igipimo gikurikiraho kizagereranywa na cyo.
pay.waitingBody: MTN Mobile Money yohereje kuri {phone} icyifuzo cyo kwishyura {amount}. Andika umubare w'ibanga wa MoMo kugira ngo ucyemeze.
pay.sandboxNote: Sisitemu y'igerageza: MTN yemeza ubwayo kwishyura kw'igerageza mu masegonda make, kandi nta mafaranga nyayo akoreshwa.
pay.stillWaiting: MTN Mobile Money ntirasubiza. Niba mwemeje kwishyura, fagitire iragaragara ko yishyuwe vuba: banza urebe fagitire zawe mbere yo kongera kwishyura.
pay.declinedBody: Nta mafaranga yavuye kuri konti yawe. Mushobora kongera kugerageza.
pay.testMode: Kwishyura kw'igerageza: nta mafaranga nyayo yakoreshejwe.
landing.perkFair: Buri fagitire igereranywa n'ibyo usanzwe ukoresha

home.decision.rejectedBody: Ntitwashoboye kwemeza igipimo giheruka. Ohereza indi foto y'imibare.

push.onBody: Iyi telefoni izakumenyesha igihe umukozi agenzuye igipimo cyawe.
push.blocked: Ubutumwa bwahagaritswe kuri uru rubuga. Emera notifications mu igenamiterere rya mushakisha kugira ngo bukore.
signin.panel1: Fata icyemezo vuba ku bipimo byahagaritswe, ifoto iri iruhande
signin.panel2: Reba ibyo ingo zishyura n'ibyo zikoresha
staff.overview.welcomeBody: Ibipimo byahagaritswe ntibikorerwa fagitire kugeza umuntu abifasheho icyemezo.
landing.value1: Erekeza telefoni kuri mubazi. Mubazi igusomera imibare umunani, nawe ukayigenzura.
landing.value2: Buri gipimo kigereranywa n'ibyo usanzwe ukoresha, kandi umukozi wa WASAC agenzura ikidasanzwe.
landing.value3: Emeza fagitire ukoresheje umubare w'ibanga wa MTN Mobile Money. Inyemezabwishyu iza kuri SMS.
landing.featureUssdTitle: Ikora kuri telefoni iyo ari yo yose
landing.featureUssd: Nta telefoni igezweho? Kanda menu ya USSD wohereze igipimo, urebe fagitire cyangwa wishyure.
landing.featureLeak: Iyo ukoresha amazi menshi bitunguranye, tukubwira icyo ugenzura, kugira ngo amazi ameneka aboneke kare.
landing.featureLanguage: Buri paji mu Kinyarwanda no mu Cyongereza.
landing.featureHistory: Buri fagitire, n'amazi wakoresheje buri kwezi.
landing.featureSignIn: Kode kuri SMS. Nta jambo ry'ibanga ryo kwibuka.
landing.ctaText: Bifata nk'umunota umwe, kandi uhita ubona fagitire yawe.
landing.footerAbout: Fagitire y'amazi ku bafatabuguzi ba WASAC mu Rwanda: soma mubazi, genzura fagitire, wishyure.
landing.footerCopy: © {year} Mubazi. Umushinga wa capstone, African Leadership University.
pay.momoPayLede: Ishyura {amount} kuri WASAC ukoresheje MTN Mobile Money, hanyuma utubwire nimero y'igikorwa.
pay.momoPayStep1: 1. Kanda iyi kode hanyuma winjize umubare w'ibanga wa MoMo
pay.momoPayNoCode: Koresha kode ya MoMo Pay ya WASAC iri kuri fagitire yawe, cyangwa ubaze WASAC kuri 1580.
pay.momoPayStep2Hint: Iri mu butumwa MTN yohereza nyuma yo kwishyura, urugero 12345678901.
pay.momoPayBadId: Andika nimero y'igikorwa uko iri mu butumwa bwa MTN (inyuguti n'imibare).
pay.checkingBody: WASAC irimo guhuza igikorwa {id} ({amount}) na konti yayo ya MoMo. Fagitire izagaragara ko yishyuwe nimara kwemezwa, kandi uzabona SMS.
staff.payments.lede: Ubwishyu bwa MoMo Pay butegereje kugenzurwa. Shaka buri nimero y'igikorwa muri konti ya WASAC ya MoMo mbere yo kwemeza.
staff.payments.declined: Ubwishyu bwa {name} bwanzwe. Bamenyeshejwe kuri SMS.
staff.payments.how: Uko bigenzurwa: fungura konti ya WASAC ya MoMo (portal cyangwa raporo), shaka nimero y'igikorwa n'amafaranga, hanyuma wemeze. Iyo MoMo API ihujwe, MTN yemeza ubwishyu ubwayo kandi ntibutegerereza hano.
staff.household.addLede: Urugo ruhita rushobora kwinjira rukoresheje iyi nimero ya telefoni. Ingo ntizishobora kwifungurira konti ubwazo.
staff.household.editLede: Hindura izina, nimero ya telefoni, umurenge cyangwa nimero y'uruganda. Nimero ya mubazi ntihinduka. Buri gihinduka kiri mu Bikorwa.
staff.household.name: Izina
staff.household.phoneHint: Nimero urugo rwinjiriraho. Mubazi nyinshi zishobora gusangira nimero imwe.
staff.household.readingHint: Icyo mubazi yerekana uyu munsi. Ifoto ya mbere igereranywa na cyo.
staff.household.customerHint: Nimero y'umukiriya ya WASAC. Siga ubusa kugira ngo ikorwe.
staff.household.taken: Iyo nimero ya mubazi, nimero y'uruganda cyangwa nimero y'umukiriya isanzwe yanditswe.
staff.household.invalid: Hari amakuru atari yo. Reba buri gice wongere ugerageze.
staff.household.added: {name} yongeweho na mubazi {meter}. Ashobora kwinjira ubu.

staff.household.err.customer: Koresha inyuguti, imibare, - cyangwa / gusa, bidatangirwa na DEMO-.

staff.household.err.dup_serial: Iyi nimero y'uruganda iri no ku murongo {value}.

staff.household.err.demo_household: Uru ni urugo rw'igerageza; urutonde ntirushobora kuruhindura.
staff.import.title: Ohereza urutonde rw'ingo
staff.import.lede: Ku rutonde rw'abakiriya ba WASAC: dosiye ya CSV ibitswe ivuye muri spreadsheet. Ubona ibizahinduka mbere y'uko hagira ikibikwa. Umurongo ufite mubazi isanzwe yanditswe uvugurura urwo rugo.
staff.import.columns: Inkingi: name, phone, meter_number, sector; serial_number, first_reading na customer_number si ngombwa.
staff.import.fixFirst: Imirongo {count} ifite amakosa. Yikosore muri dosiye, hanyuma wongere uyohereze. Nta kintu cyabitswe.
staff.import.done: Byabitswe: {added} byongeweho, {updated} byavuguruwe. Bashobora kwinjira ubu.
staff.import.badFile: Iyi dosiye ntiyasomwe. Ikeneye inkingi name, phone, meter_number na sector. Kuramo dosiye y'urugero urebe uko iteye.
staff.import.tooBig: Iyi dosiye ni nini cyane. Ohereza ingo 5,000 gusa icyarimwe.
staff.import.field.name: izina
